description: Query public DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA) with TTLs for any public domain name, choosing between server default, Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Google (8.8.8.8) or Quad9 (9.9.9.9). Rejects private/local domains. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/dns-lookup.
